Saved Views is available today, included in every paid plan. It lets you turn your favorite filters, sorting, and grouping into a single click, so you never have to rebuild the same list every morning. Set one up for your sprint backlog, overdue tasks, or high-priority bugs, and it stays ready whenever you need it.

Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room for personal dashboards alongside team-wide setups. Better still, any view can be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same filters and priorities instead of recreating them individually.

Whether you manage one project or several, Saved Views keeps your team aligned without extra setup, and it works across boards, lists, and calendars, updating automatically as your data changes. It's a small addition that removes a lot of repetitive clicking, and it's ready for you right now.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
